content:
## Request Context
- What was requested: Run an augmented quarterly meta-review (macro/double-loop) to verify the framework is achieving its ends. Developer chose meta-review over retro after discussing the distinction.
- Files/scope: Whole framework, evaluated through the HUB LENS — cross-instance telemetry from template + agentic_journal + VerificationPortal + howie_family_wiki (not template-local only).
- Developer-stated motivation: This repo is the hub of all their projects; lots of recent changes (ADR-0016 restructure, /distribute); wants best thinking + maximum effort to ensure the framework achieves its ends.
- Explicit constraints: Augmented run — hub-denominator telemetry, opus adversarial panel (architecture-consultant + independent-perspective + steward), seeded with the /distribute self-confirming-verification blind-spot as a double-loop case study. Principle #7: developer decides all adjustments.

DRAFT meta-review at docs/sprints/META-REVIEW-20260523.md. Headlines: (1) hub denominator confirmed — hub=7% of real use, agentic_journal=85%. (2) SURVIVAL COLLAPSE — 0-11% of specialist findings reach synthesis; we reward volume not impact, and the hub dashboard lacks survival_pct entirely. (3) independent-perspective = lowest dispatch (9) but highest survival (11%) + caught the /distribute blind spot — under-weighted highest-impact agent. (4) DOMAIN-FIT misalignment — ux-evaluator 42 findings frontend / 0 backend; security inverse; uniform template defaults misfit every project -> domain-tiered panels. (5) METRICS SCHEMA DRIFT hub vs derived (v_agent_dashboard diverged) — can't measure apples-to-apples; /distribute is the remedy. (6) education gate near-unused downstream despite Principle #6. (7) advisory flood 7.9:1.4 per review w/ ~6% survival = over-flagging. (8) decision-churn healthy 1/16. Double-loop: unguarded class = self-confirming verification (test fixture shared code's assumption). Verdict frame: achieving ends on VALUES, leaking effort on EXECUTION.

Meta-review panel (opus, conf 0.86). MAJOR catch: finding D RESTATES ADR-0012 (accepted 2026-04-05, educator already rebuilt for the non-coding decision-maker — Vocabulary/Relationships/Judgment tiers). The draft didn't cite it. So D is NOT a new redesign; the real gap is ADR-0012 accepted-but-unrealized DOWNSTREAM = propagation gap (/distribute) OR gate-invocation wiring. Developer testimony CONFIRMS ADR-0012 was right; the 'possibility-space' framing may be a real EXTENSION (=> new ADR superseding 0012, not an uncited adjustment). HIGH latent bug: meta-review.md ITSELF queries v_agent_dashboard for total_findings/survival_pct the HUB VIEW LACKS (init_db.py:227-243) — silently swallowed by except; CAPTURE_PIPELINE.md:19 claims survival is computed, compute_agent_effectiveness.py never computes it. Schema drift is ASYMMETRIC: hub is unambiguously stale; B is a full additive migration (column+compute+view), not a one-line view edit. A (domain-tiered panels) must be selection-SETS via selecting-review-gates + ADR-0010 dispatch-reframe, NOT agent duplication (else roster fragmentation). A/B/E cross boundaries -> need ADRs (B folds into ADR-0013, still 'proposed'). Decision-churn 1/16 is incomplete: ADR-0016 moved ~15 rule files in ONE ADR; docs/code drifted un-ADR'd. 'Principles not thrashing' != 'system not drifting.'

Meta-meta check (opus, conf 0.82). (1) Survival metric is UNSOUND as headline (conf 0.9): the hub cannot compute it (no survival in compute_agent_effectiveness.py, no column, no view); its definition lives in ANOTHER repo; the SAME agent (independent-perspective) is recorded at 0% survival in memory/projects/agentic-journal.md but 11% in this draft (unreconciled); prior syntheses (2026-05-15/16) explicitly called survival 'not-yet-trustworthy/infrastructure-not-built.' DEMOTE survival from headline to hypothesis; the honest headline is 'we lack a trustworthy impact metric — and THAT is the finding.' (2) The draft measures MECHANICS and reports a verdict on ENDS (conf 0.85): every quantitative input is an output-metric; the framework's actual ends (creativity-actuation, anti-extraction, reasoning-primary) are unmeasured; 'values working' rests on ONE anecdote. The education-gate finding is the ONLY real ends-test AND a human had to supply it — the instrument can't distinguish 'operational slack' from 'values failure.' Promote it to headline. (3) VP-went-quiet = survivorship bias (conf 0.78): activity-weighted evaluation cannot hear from projects that left; VP (smallest, now silent) had the misfit panel — framework OVERHEAD may have stalled it; the quietest instance carries the loudest signal. (4) Unexamined assumption: that 90% discard is bad — a review system SHOULD filter; what's the RIGHT survival rate? Never argued. Self-flattery flag: the 'under-weight independent-perspective' counter-signal flatters the reviewing agent and rests on the contradicted 11%. Alt frame: framework has ~1 real user (agentic_journal); the meta-review apparatus may be overfit to it + its own overhead mirrors what may have stalled VP. Fix (OKR/SPACE): add ONE human-reported outcome question per instance ('did it help you ship something you understand + are proud of?').

STEWARD VERDICT: APPROVE (conf 0.88). The framework is SOUND and achieving its ends; constitutional layer (independence, Prime Objective, ADR stability) demonstrably works — verified the /distribute extraction-catch against BUILD_STATUS (Principle #4 caught a Prime-Objective B1 defect 3 checkpoints+gate+32 tests missed). AFFIRMS the education-gate reading IN FULL: values-level miss, not operational. Gate-as-built teaches OUTPUT(code) while Principle #1 declares REASONING primary; hollow Principle-#7 approval (rubber-stamp telemetry); reproduces the manager-maker alienation the Prime Objective exists to dissolve, on the founder. 're-aim, not retire' is philosophically correct (PHILOSOPHY.md:82 'a feature that can't be understood can't empower anyone'). Two-project corroboration (project_verification_portal.md): survival<=12.5%, 83% advisory, domain misfit, education dead-letter = Rule-of-Three grade. SHARPENING: the advisory-flood (5.5:1, ~6% survival) is NOT pure execution slack — it's a values-ADJACENT drift toward process-for-its-own-sake (PHILOSOPHY.md:5), 'ceremony vs thought'; name it honestly. Velocity: evolving COHERENTLY not accreting (1/16 churn; ADR-0016 was consolidation) — but DON'T open 6 fronts: finish /distribute (F) FIRST (A+B can't deploy without it); sequence F->B->A; D+E on their own GATED track. GATE REQUIREMENTS (Framework Evolution + Principle #7): D (educator redefinition) REQUIRES Steward gate+dev approval — pre-disposed APPROVE the direction; E (new rule) REQUIRES gate (argue prompt-vs-rule per #8); A (dispatch defaults) borderline->gate; C split (independent-weighting->gate, advisory-budget->normal); B+F no gate (tooling; F mid-flight under approved plan). Answer 2 open Qs before finalizing: survival-undercount validity; and VP-went-quiet (a Prime-Objective question — dispatch a focused look). Persona-bias check: not defending my original conception — the evidence indicts exactly the teach-the-dev-to-read-code gate I'd have first built; the framework has healthily grown past my original notion of who the human-in-the-loop is.

FINAL (incorporating opus panel). Steward verdict APPROVE (0.88): framework is SOUND and achieving its ends — constitutional layer (independence, Prime Objective, ADR stability) works, proven by the /distribute Principle-#4 catch. The panel corrected the draft on 3 counts: (1) survival_pct is uncomputable on the hub + contradicts a recorded baseline + was declared not-yet-trustworthy a week ago -> DEMOTE from headline to hypothesis; honest finding = 'we lack a trustworthy impact metric, and that IS the finding' (directional pattern still corroborated across VP+IJ at Rule-of-Three grade). (2) The education re-aim RESTATES ADR-0012 (already accepted + educator already rebuilt); developer testimony CONFIRMS it; real gap = propagation/invocation, with 'possibility-space' a possible ADR-0012 EXTENSION. (3) The draft measured MECHANICS, reported a verdict on ENDS; the education finding (human-supplied) is the only real ends-test -> the instrument can't tell slack from values-failure without a human. Recursive: the meta-review's OWN instrument is drifted (meta-review.md queries hub-absent columns; CAPTURE_PIPELINE.md claims uncomputed metrics). Honest verdict = constitutional values sound + EARLY values-adjacent drift in the review economy (process-for-its-own-sake, PHILOSOPHY.md:5) + uncomputable self-measurement. Sequence F(finish /distribute)->B(survival metric+schema sync)->A(domain-tiered selection-sets); D(educator re-aim)+E(verification-challenges-assumptions rule)+A-dispatch-defaults REQUIRE Steward gate + dev approval (directions pre-approved). 3 developer questions left open: is 90% discard even bad (right survival rate undefined)?; is the apparatus overfit to agentic_journal (~85%)?; did framework OVERHEAD stall VerificationPortal (went quiet 2026-05-16 — Prime-Objective question, dispatch a focused look). Report docs/sprints/META-REVIEW-20260523.md stays status:draft pending those developer rulings.
